2610.10513.title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?
2610.10513.paper_summary: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. The AI Science Exam for El Nino-Southern Oscillation (SciExam for ENSO) is a benchmark in which agents build low-order stochastic models of ENSO, the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, from real observations. Within a six-hour budget, agents process the observations, write their own diagnostics, which are then frozen, and develop a model using only these diagnostics as feedback. Hidden graders then test whether the model reproduces ENSO's statistics, recovers unobserved variables, and forecasts held-out years, and score a published model in the same way. Across twelve agent systems, six produce models that score higher than the published model, mainly through better reconstruction and forecasting. The simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two competing explanations of ENSO's warm-cold asymmetry, an open debate that the task never mentions. Controlled runs of the top system under varied information suggest that its scores do not come from recalling the dated observational record and that the information it receives shapes how it builds its model. SciExam for ENSO can thus evaluate agent research where no answer is known, and the results suggest that agents can already build competitive models whose structures bear on questions that scientists still debate.
2610.10513.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型代理人越來越多地被要求進行開放式的科學研究，然而他們的結果通常是根據已知的答案、評分標準或語言模型審核者進行評分，而這些都無法判斷新的科學模型是否有效。AI 科學考試針對厄爾尼諾-南方震盪（SciExam for ENSO）是一個基準，代理人從真實觀測數據中構建低階隨機模型，這是年際氣候變異的主導模式。在六小時的預算內，代理人處理觀測數據，撰寫自己的診斷，然後這些診斷會被凍結，並僅使用這些診斷作為反饋來開發模型。隱藏的評分者然後測試該模型是否重現了ENSO的統計數據，恢復未觀察到的變量，並預測保留的年份，並以相同的方式對已發表的模型進行評分。在十二個代理系統中，有六個生成的模型得分高於已發表的模型，主要是通過更好的重建和預測。更強模型的簡化形式各自與ENSO的暖冷不對稱的兩種競爭解釋之一相容，這是一個該任務從未提及的開放性辯論。在不同信息下對頂級系統的控制運行表明，其得分並不是來自回憶過時的觀測記錄，而是其接收到的信息塑造了它構建模型的方式。因此，SciExam for ENSO 可以評估沒有已知答案的代理研究，結果表明代理人已經能夠構建競爭性的模型，其結構涉及科學家仍在辯論的問題。
